description: Ecological ceilings and social foundations are jointly governed through rights public investment restoration and low-carbon systems.
International cooperation improves around climate biodiversity oceans chemicals finance and technology transfer.
Regions rebuild food water energy land and infrastructure systems around restoration and local resilience.
Clean energy efficiency technology and markets reduce some impacts while economic expansion continues.
Societies delay structural change and rely heavily on future technologies to manage overshoot.
Regions adapt unevenly while planetary cooperation weakens and boundary pressures remain high.
Adaptation protects high-value assets while vulnerable communities face abandonment and rising ecological risk.
Extraction fossil dependence land conversion inequality and weak governance continue until crises force reactive measures.
